SvShuntCompensatorSections.sections.title: sections
SvShuntCompensatorSections.sections.description: The number of sections in service as a continuous variable. The attribute shall be a positive value or zero. To get integer value scale with ShuntCompensator.bPerSection.

SvShuntCompensatorSections.phase.title: phase
SvShuntCompensatorSections.phase.description: The terminal phase at which the connection is applied.   If missing, the injection is assumed to be balanced among non-neutral phases.

Ravens.cimObjectType.title: cimObjectType
Ravens.cimObjectType.description: Used in RAVENS Schema to identify the corresponding CIM Object Type of the JSON object.

title: SvShuntCompensatorSections
description: State variable for the number of sections in service for a shunt compensator.
